# Alter Reviews

### The community submitted 10 reviews to tell us what they like about Alter, what Alter can do better, and more.

5.0

Based on 10 reviews

Review Alter?

Reviewers describe Alter as a Mac AI tool they use constantly because it fits directly into daily work instead of sending them back to browser tabs and chat windows. The most repeated praise is for strong context awareness across apps and on-screen content, fast access to many current models, customizable actions and shortcuts, and workflow features like dictation, smart pasting, meeting transcription and summaries, file handling, and privacy-friendly local options. Users also highlight frequent updates and responsive founders, though one reviewer wants a better chat interface and easier history access.

# Alter Reviews [...] Report

 127 views

•1 review

Alter has become my absolute go-to, most-used AI application, evolving from an already great tool into something truly indispensable for my daily workflow. I've watched it grow, and it's clear the team deeply understands the AI space and is passionate about building a genuinely useful, native macOS assistant. Its seamless context-awareness across all apps, powerful instant actions, time-saving meeting summaries, accessible voice commands, and solid privacy features (including local model support) make it feel like a natural extension of my Mac. Honestly, I can't imagine my workday without Alter readily accessible – it's that integrated and essential now.
